1.web: An unfriendly man pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
1.asv: He that separateth himself seeketh his own desire, And rageth against all sound wisdom.

2.web: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
2.asv: A fool hath no delight in understanding, But only that his heart may reveal itself.

3.web: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.
3.asv: When the wicked cometh, there cometh also contempt, And with ignominy cometh reproach.

4.web: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
4.asv: The words of a man’s mouth areasdeep waters; The wellspring of wisdom is as a flowing brook.

5.web: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
5.asv: To respect the person of the wicked is not good, Norto turn aside the righteous in judgment.

6.web: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
6.asv: A fool’s lips enter into contention, And his mouth calleth for stripes.

7.web: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
7.asv: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, And his lips are the snare of his soul.

8.web: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
8.asv: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts.

9.web: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
9.asv: He also that is slack in his work Is brother to him that is a destroyer.

10.web: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
10.asv: The name of Jehovah is a strong tower; The righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

11.web: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
11.asv: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, And as a high wall in his own imagination.

12.web: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
12.asv: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty; And before honorgoethhumility.

13.web: He who gives answer before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
13.asv: He that giveth answer before he heareth, It is folly and shame unto him.

14.web: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
14.asv: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; But a broken spirit who can bear?

15.web: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
15.asv: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; And the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

16.web: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
16.asv: A man’s gift maketh room for him, And bringeth him before great men.

17.web: He who pleads his cause first seems right; until another comes and questions him.
17.asv: He that pleadeth his cause first seemeth just; But his neighbor cometh and searcheth him out.

18.web: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
18.asv: The lot causeth contentions to cease, And parteth between the mighty.

19.web: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city; and disputes are like the bars of a castle.
19.asv: A brother offendedis harder to be won than a strong city; Andsuchcontentions are like the bars of a castle.

20.web: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
20.asv: A man’s belly shall be filled with the fruit of his mouth; With the increase of his lips shall he be satisfied.

21.web: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
21.asv: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; And they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

22.web: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.
22.asv: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, And obtaineth favor of Jehovah.

23.web: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
23.asv: The poor useth entreaties; But the rich answereth roughly.

24.web: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
24.asv: He that maketh many friends doeth it to his own destruction; But there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
